newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Kloeckner buy of Arus Distribution.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Kloeckner buy of Arus Distribution.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it had cleared the purchase by Germany's Kloeckner Stahl and Metallhandel GmbH of French company Arus Distribution SA.

The Commission said in a statement the proposed purchase by Kloeckner, which is linked to German industrial group VIAG AG, "would not lead to increased market share" in the relevant countries -- Germany, France and Britain.
Arus stores and distributes steel products for industry, ironmongers and the heating and sanitary industries.
Within the VIAG group, similar activities take part within VIAG's KSM and its subsidiaries which also distribute aluminium and other non-ferrous metals. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
